title: June
desc: June, a teenager, believes that there is nothing remarkable about her. She experiences adolescent crushes, handles heartbreaks and fights insecurities as she grows into a mature and confident woman.

title: Loham
desc: When Jayanthi's husband, Ramesh, who is accused in a gold smuggling case, goes missing, she comes to Kochi to find him. In her quest to locate him, she comes across Raju, a taxi driver.

title: Magic Oven
desc: A renowned chef shares and demonstrates the method to prepare various delicious recipes that can be easily made at home.

title: Yaanai
desc: Ravi, the youngest son of an influential family accused of causing a man's death, takes charge of defending them. However, amidst the turmoil, he unexpectedly falls for a woman.

title: Ratsasan
desc: Following his father's death, a man gives up on his dream to become a filmmaker and joins the police force. He then attempts to track down a psychopathic killer who targets schoolgirls.

title: K-Ramp
desc: A rich businessman, Krishna, sends his wayward son, Kumar, to Kerala in order to reform him. There, Kumar falls for Mercy, a girl with PTSD and suicidal tendencies.
